runtimeContractSources.observation: The public command shape documents planFile and todoId as strings with exact None sentinel.
The C# call accepts nullable inputs and normalizes blank values to exact None in new TurnState; supersession is stateful.
The wrapper stamps None only for non-reopen and omits bound metadata on exact same-request reopen.
The hook always supplies resolved planFile/todoId, using exact None when no association exists.

schemaSourceVerification.plannedNonbreakingAssertion: The schema must add planFile/todoId properties and document the state-dependent contract, but must not globally require them or add a discriminator because exact durable reopen and canceled/cancelled supersession are approved omission cases.
